agentStarters.reply:
**Nothing is open — Harpreet Kaur Gill is not a customer yet.**

The only thing on file is the **export packing credit enquiry** logged on 17 Sep 2026. There is no account, no card and no prior activity with IDBI.

What exists instead is an onboarding assessment built from Account Aggregator, bureau and GST data, and it scores **23/100 (Stressed)**. Receipts land every month; it is utilisation and repayment timing that pull the score down.

agentStarters.label: Which products can be pre-checked?

steps.text: Read AA data — 96% utilisation on the external cash credit
Read bureau — one instalment 31 days late

agentStarters.reply:
**One, and it is not a credit product.**

| Product | Verdict | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Export packing credit | **Hold** | External limit drawn to 96% for three months |
| Any fresh limit | **Hold** | ₹27.40L outstanding against ₹47.20L of turnover |
| Current account | **Proceed** | No credit risk, and it starts a conduct record |

**Open the current account.** Her ₹47.20L of turnover runs entirely through two other banks, so we have nothing of our own to lend against. Route part of the collections through IDBI for three months, then the limit conversation becomes possible.

agentStarters.label: How should I prepare for the next call?

steps.text: Checked what documents would change the answer

agentStarters.reply:
**Lead with what you can offer.**

- Open with the **current account** — it is the yes in the conversation, and it costs her nothing.
- If she raises the packing credit, be specific about what would change it: **two clean GST filing cycles** and **utilisation below 85% for three months**. That is a date, not a refusal.
- Ask how the last two quarters have gone rather than quoting her own numbers back at her.

**What to collect:** the last two GST challans, six months of statements from the existing banks, and the machinery loan sanction letter.

**Ritu Joshi has 1 open matter.**

1. **Credit card application** — submitted 16 Sep, awaiting video KYC before issue.

agentStarters.label: Summarise the open matters
agentStarters.reply:
**Simran Sethi joined yesterday.**

1. **Salary account onboarding** — opened 18 Sep through the Arcline Systems payroll mandate, video KYC completed the same day. Resolved.

Nothing else is open. She is **new to credit** — no loan, no card, no bureau history — so there is no repayment record to read yet. A welcome call is scheduled for 25 Sep.

agentStarters.label: Which products can be pre-checked?

steps.text: Read the salary credit — ₹64,000 a month

agentStarters.reply:
**Go gently — the file is one day old.**

| Product | Verdict | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unsecured card | **Wait** | No bureau history to underwrite |
| Secured card | **Proceed** | Builds a record against a small deposit |
| SIP | **Proceed** | ₹18,000 a month is unallocated |
| Personal loan | **No** | No need, and no history to price |

**Let three salary credits land** before anything unsecured. A ₹5,000 SIP on the salary date and a secured card start the record safely.

agentStarters.label: How should I prepare for the next call?

steps.text: Checked what a new-to-credit file needs first

agentStarters.reply:
**Make it a welcome, not a sale.**

- Confirm the salary credit landed and the net-banking setup works.
- Explain the package benefits she already has — that is why the relationship stays.
- Offer **one** thing: a ₹5,000 SIP on the salary date. Habit before products.
- Flag that a secured card would start her credit history, and that three clean months open the unsecured options.

She is 26 and new to credit. What you do in the first quarter decides whether the next ten years of her banking sit here.
